column12: generous for this study and the reason should be read before the number is used. The published rate describes randomised Phase 3 programmes; NCT03969329 is single arm, open label, n = 24, with percent change from baseline in iPTH at weeks 20 to 26 as its primary outcome. A paediatric extension of an adult label under PREA usually succeeds on pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics rather than on a controlled effect, which argues the rate is if anything low; against that, the 24-patient enrolment has been recruiting since 2019-12-20 and slips, not efficacy, are the risk here
